title: REPTILE WEEK
seo_title: Reptile Week at Show Me Reptile Shop, Springfield MO
description: Reptile Week is a nine-day event at Show Me Reptile Shop in Springfield, MO, with reptile education, classes and talks, feeding demonstrations, feeder and food deals, giveaways, and a Reptile Adoption Day. Highlights include a holiday kickoff with Santa pictures and hot cocoa on Dec 5, Ambassador Sunday meet and greets at 12 PM and 3 PM on Dec 6, and a Grand Finale on Dec 13. It is aimed at families, first-time pet owners, and experienced reptile keepers, and runs Dec 5 (9:00 AM) to Dec 13 (5:00 PM), 2026, at 3235 E Sunshine St; promotions and giveaways are subject to availability and event terms.
